name: game-code-review
description: Invoke when the user wants a game-specific code review, architecture check, or technical analysis of game code. Covers frame independence, hot path performance, state machine integrity, and resource lifecycle. Triggers on: "code review", "review my code", "check architecture", "game code quality". Do NOT invoke for design document review (use game-design-review) or general sprint planning (use game-sprint-plan). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.
